approval.approvalContext: The authenticated user authorized exactly two fresh replacement candidates while preserving Seojin identity: one true-alpha character single image and one true-alpha six-frame right-facing decisive attack. Existing candidates remain immutable until each replacement independently completes PASS with passForProjectCopy=true.

seojin.attack.allowed_intentional_vertic.value: pose articulation only; pelvis/world-root and ground baseline remain exactly fixed

value.dynamicPigment: Bounded open-ink and pastel accents support the slash but are excluded from root, baseline and scale measurement and never become background.

frameContinuityAnchors.policy: all anchors remain continuous across the provider-native GIF timeline

keyPoseOrder.pose: Quiet right-facing ready stance with fixed support foot and pelvis; sword and scabbard controlled close to the body.
Compact anticipation: knees and hips load while the root and baseline remain unchanged.
Acceleration begins through pelvis and torso; the hwando enters one continuous rightward cutting path.
Decisive contact peak: one strong readable rightward slash with fixed support and coherent blade alignment.
Immediate controlled stop with only bounded ink and garment lag; no second attack.
Balanced recovery guard preserving direction, identity, equipment, root, baseline and scale.

value.motionDirection: One coherent right-facing decisive slash progresses once through anticipation, acceleration, contact, stop and recovery without root translation or a second attack.
value.swordArc: One bounded rightward cutting trajectory; the hwando remains continuous with hand, scabbard and equipment identity and stays inside the safe margin.
value.torsoRotation: Pelvis initiates, torso and shoulder follow, and the blade resolves into one controlled contact and recovery while support remains grounded.

value: Do not include matte, checkerboard, halo, vignette, floor, scene, cast shadow, residual fringe, opaque background residue, clipping, neighboring-cell fragments, background flicker, frame-canvas mismatch, scale pumping, or independent silhouette recentering.

Do not move the pelvis/world-root or ground baseline, let dynamic pigment alter anchor measurement, place sword or effects outside safe bounds, reverse attack direction, reorder frames, redesign identity or equipment, or create a second attack.
Do not use a still image, contact sheet, sprite sheet, video, or independently generated frame-set fallback as the animation source.
Do not promote or replace the current project animation before completed PASS and passForProjectCopy=true.

Deliver exactly one right-facing decisive single attack as one provider-native animated GIF with exactly six ordered frames and six extracted true-alpha PNG frames; anticipation, contact and recovery must be coherent and equipment identity continuous.

All six PNG frames use the identical 640x512 canvas, pelvis/world-root coordinate (320,400), ground baseline y=440, and fixed 1:1 character scale with exactly 0 px pelvis drift and exactly 0 px baseline drift after deterministic packaging.

Preserve the approved Seojin identity, compact 4.25-head body, low topknot, simplified one-shoulder armor, hwando and left-waist scabbard, open broken ink line and restrained rough pigment while keeping every sword and effect pixel inside the 24 px safe margin.

Every pixel outside the intended character, equipment and controlled dynamic pigment silhouette in every extracted frame has alpha exactly 0; generation and preservation validate alpha-mask, fringe, anchor, baseline, canvas, scale, flicker and bounds evidence before completion.

seojin.attack.scale_lock.v14.value: fixed 1:1 character scale across the provider GIF timeline and all six extracted frames; no per-frame rescale, crop, padding, zoom, or silhouette recentering

value: Do not include an opaque or warm-ivory matte, checkerboard pixels, halo, vignette, floor, scene, cast shadow, residual background fringe, or any nontransparent background pixel outside intended foreground.
Do not crop the figure, equipment, weapon, scabbard or controlled pigment, and do not promote or replace the current project candidate before completed PASS and passForProjectCopy=true.

Preserve the approved Seojin young-adult Korean/Joseon identity, compact 4.25-head proportion, low topknot, simplified one-shoulder armor, left-waist sheathed hwando, open broken mok-seon, and restrained indigo, gray-brown and ochre pigment roles without redesign.

Deliver one RGBA PNG whose every pixel outside the intended character, equipment and controlled pigment silhouette has alpha exactly 0; artistically bounded partial alpha is allowed only inside that intended foreground.
Keep the complete figure, hwando, scabbard, equipment and controlled pigment inside the canvas with at least 24 pixels of clear safe margin and no clipping.
Generation and preservation must validate alpha-mask, fringe and safe-bound evidence before declaring the replacement preview or package complete.
